purpose: Describe how someone or something appears visually.
keywords: Noun / な-adjective + に見える; い-adjective ～く見える.
That cloud looks like a dog.
I look younger when I wear these clothes.
formation: Noun / な-adjective + に見える; い-adjective ～く見える.
restrictions: Reports appearance rather than asserting the underlying reality.
mistake: Use 若く見える, not 若いに見える.
